description: MeshKernel is Deltares' C++ library for creating and editing one- and two-dimensional unstructured meshes and curvilinear grids. It constructs triangular meshes inside polygons, generates river grids from splines, refines selected areas and balances mesh orthogonality with smoothness for finite-volume flow solvers. Inputs are geometry, sample information and meshing settings; outputs are meshes for subsequent numerical modelling. Coverage is global at user-selected domain and resolution, with no observation period. Public source is free under LGPL-2.1. The documented MeshKernelPy wrapper is MIT, but its distributed wheels bundle the LGPL core; a .NET wrapper is also linked. A limitation is that mesh preparation does not establish hydraulic accuracy, and compilation requires compatible C++20, Boost and NetCDF dependencies. The library can prepare domains for flow simulations with Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm) and other appropriate solvers. Both core and Python wrapper READMEs were inspected, including their different terms. No binary, model mesh or dependency archive was downloaded.
licence: Core: LGPL-2.1; MeshKernelPy wrapper: MIT (wheels bundle LGPL core)
